title: Kilo Architecture Ratchet Allowlist
description: Baseline exception list for Kilo-owned domain architecture boundaries and state ratchets on the v2 package layout. Upstream-owned shared opencode files are exempt to prevent upstream merge conflicts. As Kilo legacy sites are refactored into clean Effect layers, decrement counts or remove entries to lock in progress.

core-directionality.description: Forbidden imports in packages/schema/src, packages/core/src, packages/protocol/src, and packages/client/src. Target: domain packages depend only in the allowed direction.

kilo-gateway-core-isolation.description: Imports from @opencode/* in packages/kilo-gateway-core/src. Target: Kilo logic packages stay independent of @opencode/*.

kilo-instance-state.description: Legacy InstanceState.make usages in Kilo-owned code (packages/kilo-*/src/**, packages/*/src/kilocode/**). Target: encapsulate in scoped Effect Services in packages/core.

kilo-database-constructors.description: Direct new Database() / new DatabaseSync() instantiations in Kilo-owned code. Target: all persistence routes through core Database.Service.

packages/kilo-cli/src/database.ts.reason: One-time copy of an earlier build's database file before the server starts. It counts sessions in the candidate files and opens the best one read-only for VACUUM INTO, a consistent snapshot even while that build still writes; Database.Service does not exist yet and would run migrations on the old file. Remove with the legacy copy.

kilo-tool-process-env.description: Direct process.env reads in Kilo-owned tools. Target: pass configuration explicitly via Tool.Context or Env.Service.

kilo-httpapi-handlers.description: Raw OS or process operations in Kilo-owned HTTP handler files. Target: delegate to domain Effect services.

kilo-test-process-state.description: Process-wide state in Kilo-owned tests (packages/kilo-*/test/**, packages/*/test/kilocode/**, and *.test, *.spec and __tests__ files next to Kilo source): mock.module, spyOn(globalThis), and module-scope global or process.env writes. bun test runs all files of a package in one process, so this state leaks into the next files. bunfig preload files are exempt. Target: inject the dependency, or set and restore the value in hooks.

packages/cli/test/kilocode/config/update.reason: Spies on the global fetch to observe outgoing requests. Target: inject the fetch function.

packages/kilo-cli/test/fixtures/logo-pre.reason: Entry script of a branding child process: it runs in its own process, so the env write cannot leak into other test files.

kilo-test-blocking-spawn.description: Synchronous child processes (spawnSync, execSync, execFileSync) in Kilo-owned tests. They block the test process, so Bun cannot stop the test at its timeout, and the timeout then kills shared helpers for the next files. Target: Bun.spawn with a kill timer below the test timeout.

packages/kilo-plugin/test/sandbox/linux-.reason: Sandbox probes: most calls run inside the sandboxed child script, and the rest wait for a short probe. Target: async spawn with a kill timer.

kilo-module-state.description: Top-level let, Map and Set in Kilo-owned source, counted per package. Co-located test files are not counted. Module-level state is shared by every caller in the process and needs reset hooks that couple tests. Target: keep state in an instance that a service, layer or runtime owns.
